name: Kataho
source:
The protagonist’s sex friend, whom she met on a dating site. She’s usually cheerful and popular in class, and she looks up to the protagonist, calling him “big brother.”

While she’s uninhibited when it comes to her own pleasure, she’s also thoughtful and considerate in that sense, she’s more mature than her appearance suggests.

[From [url=http://sc-crg.com/katalog/with/index.html]official site[/url]]
